phenomenon_question_hypothesis.question: Can a fresh SYSTEM successor make an equivalence claim auditable by requiring independently preserved per-producer raw streams, exact provenance bindings, verifier-side digest recomputation, and explicit separation of artifact integrity from semantic comparison?
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.hypothesis: A bounded successor is viable if every claim-relevant equality field can be derived from preserved producer bytes and exact run/ref bindings, while tampering, spoofed provenance, missing traces, and raw/digest mismatch fail closed. Floating semantic equivalence remains a separately frozen science-affecting rule rather than being inferred from digest identity.
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.observable_intervention: Future Discovery observables: per-producer manifest, raw ordered event stream, checkpoint stream, resource-counter stream, exact run/ref/provenance binding, verifier recomputed hashes and fail-closed verdict. Negative-control interventions: mutate preserved bytes after declared digest, swap producer/ref binding, omit a claim-relevant trace field, reuse same-process identity, and provide matching declared digests over nonmatching raw bytes.
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.ordinary_reductions_comparators: Current declared-digest Utility verifier and historical in-process R50 aggregate measurement are the ordinary/system baselines. The proposed successor is discriminated by verifier-side raw recomputation and provenance/trace completeness, not by post hoc scientific outcome.
phenomenon_question_hypothesis.falsifier_discriminator: HOLD/REJECT if any claim-relevant equality cannot be derived from preserved bytes without changing system/comparator semantics; if exact producer/ref provenance cannot be bound independently of producer claims; if tampered/missing raw can still yield an equivalent verdict; or if resource accounting cannot be separated from verification overhead under a fixed envelope.

admission_reassessment.reason: Question formation has reduced the ambiguity to implementation/discovery choices rather than a missing scientific question. A fresh object can prospectively test raw-chain auditability and verifier fail-closed behavior without reopening predecessor #32 or selecting a scientific floating tolerance from outcomes.
admission_reassessment.scope_guard: Initial admitted object, if any, should claim only SYSTEM-level auditability/integrity reachability. It must not claim scientific semantic equivalence or mechanism, and any tolerance-bearing floating semantic comparator requires a separately prospective Analyst-authorized contract.

fresh_successor_potential.material_newness: The successor question is not whether predecessor #32 was semantically equivalent; it asks whether a future equivalence pipeline can make every claim-relevant field independently auditable from durable producer raw bytes and authenticated bindings, with verifier-side recomputation and tamper/missing-trace negative controls.

open_choices: Choose a provenance trust root and binding mechanism for producer/run/ref identity.
Freeze exact ordered-event and checkpoint schemas plus coverage boundaries.
Freeze a resource/privilege envelope and accounting boundary that excludes verifier overhead.
If later semantic floating-state equivalence is claimed, prospectively freeze representation/tolerance in a separate science-affecting contract; do not inherit R50 1e-12 automatically.
Choose durable non-evidentiary raw-byte retention sufficient for later re-audit.
